name: main_table
description: 8-benchmark set targeted at the paper's Table 2. ~10-14h per checkpoint. MMVet and open-ended portions of others need a GPT-4-class judge — set OPENAI_API_KEY before launch, or override judge_model to an open fallback.

notes.MMVet: REQUIRES GPT-4-class judge for grading. ~$20-30/checkpoint API cost. Swap to Qwen2.5-VL-72B for sprint, GPT-4o for camera-ready.
notes.AI2D_TEST_NO_MASK: Diagram MCQ. ~3000 samples. Use the NO_MASK variant; the masked variant rewards memorization of mask placement, not reasoning.
notes.ChartQA_TEST: Structured visual reasoning over charts. Relaxed-accuracy metric; no paid judge.
notes.POPE: Hallucination yes/no questions. Binary, fast. Saturates near top of distribution — useful as a floor sanity check, not a discriminator.
